entries.en: Send an envoy who will work on building a $spy_network$ within their civilization.

entries.zh: 派出一名特使积极建立$spy_network$并增强我们的§H渗透等级§!，提供情报能让我们开展谍报行动。\n\n我们将在§Y£time£ 360§!天内无法重新指派该特使。

entries.en:
Difficulty will reduce the likelihood of getting successful results at the end of an operation phase.

Difficulty can be reduced by assigning an asset with modifier corresponding to the type of operation.

Each stage of an espionage operation can have a different difficulty value.

entries.en: §H$ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_PHASE_REPORT$§!\nThe $ESPIONAGE_OPERATION_PHASE_REPORT$ shows you the results of the last Operation Phase.

entries.en: §H$TARGET_INFO$§!\nThe $TARGET_INFO$ shows you important information about the empire you are targeting, like their §YRelative Power§! and §YRelative Encryption§!.

entries.zh: 技能加成将增加行动时段结束时成功的可能性。
entries.en: The Skill Bonus will increase the likelihood of getting successful results at the end of an operation phase.

entries.en: Insights represent useful opportunities our operatives have exploited to advance a stage of an espionage operation.\n\nInsights increases §YBreakthrough Chance§!.

entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RThis $spy_network$ already has a $role_spymaster$ assigned. See the Espionage tab for $spy_network$ information.§!

entries.en: Success is more likely if we have an §YAsset§! assigned to this Operation, sharing the same §Yprimary category§!.

entries.en: Success is more likely if we have an §YAsset§! assigned to this Operation, sharing the same §Ysecondary category§!.

entries.zh: 派遣到这项行动的§Y线人§!使我们能够采取这种行动方针。
entries.en: The §YAsset§! we have assigned to this Operation enables us to take this course of action.

entries.en: An §YAsset§! within this Spy Network enables us to take this course of action.

entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RA Spy Network can only have one active operation at a time§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们没有理由认为他们在腐蚀我们的权威§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RWe have no reason to believe they are undermining our authority§!

entries.zh: 扭曲、捏造和利用信息的行动。
entries.en: Operations which distort, fabricate and exploit information.

entries.zh: 颠覆行动几乎保证驱使战争的受害者发动进攻。
entries.en: Subversive actions almost guaranteed to put their victims on a war footing.

entries.zh: 直接打击军事、商业和民用目标的攻击性行动。
entries.en: Aggressive operations which strike directly at military, commercial and civilian targets.

entries.zh: 暗中的舆论操纵、盗窃和胁迫行为。
entries.en: Clandestine acts of opinion-swaying, theft and coercion.

entries.zh: 秘密行动，从内部潜移默化地影响一个社会。
entries.en: Undercover operations to subtly influence a society from within.

entries.zh: 我们的特工将渗透到研究实验室和系统，为我们自己的科学家提供他们正在寻找的成果。
entries.en: Our operatives will infiltrate research laboratories and systems, providing our own scientists with the answers they're looking for.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n得到一个随机的未知科技，或者是某个科技的科研进度。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nGain a random unknown Technology, or else an amount of Research.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们无法破解他们的科技和研究方法。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RTheir technology and research methods have become indecipherable to us.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §R我们必须至少要等待§Y[Root.recently_stole_technology]§!，才能再次图谋他们的科研设施。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RWe must wait until at least §Y[Root.recently_stole_technology]§! before we make another attempt on their research facilities.§!

entries.zh: 我们可以引诱或胁迫对我们的情报行动有用的特工和其他线人，以一定的代价招募他们。\n\n指派一名§Y线人§!执行这样的行动可能会有悖于他们的利益。
entries.en: We can tempt or coerce operatives and other assets who would be of use to our intelligence operations, recruiting them - for a price.\n\nAssigning an §YAsset§! to this operation may skew the results towards their interests.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n得到一个活跃于间谍网的线人。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nGain an Asset for use within this Spy Network.

entries.zh: 我们的情报人员目前需要被派至更紧急的任务，但经过精心准备，我们可以保留大部分间谍网以备将来之需。
entries.en: We have more pressing uses for our intelligence operatives at this time - but with careful preparations, we can preserve most of our Spy Network for future needs.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n停止这个间谍网内的所有活动，允许$role_spymaster$重新指派到他处，同时维持$INFILTRATION_LEVEL$不致衰减。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nCease activity within this Spy Network, allowing its $role_spymaster$ to be reassigned whilst also preventing its $INFILTRATION_LEVEL$ from decaying.

entries.zh: 恒星基地是任何帝国的中枢。如果在那里发生了一些令人遗憾的事的话……
entries.en: Starbases are the beating heart of any empire. It'd be a shame if something happened to that one.

entries.zh: 恒星基地和星环基地是任何帝国的中枢。如果在那里发生了一些令人遗憾的事的话……
entries.en: Starbases and Orbital Rings are the beating heart of any empire. It'd be a shame if something happened to that one.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n在特定的恒星基地随机摧毁一个模块或建筑。船坞不会被摧毁。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nDestroy a random Module or Building on a particular Starbase facility. Will not affect Shipyard Modules.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们只能针对恒星基地的模块和非船坞的建筑。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RWe can only target Starbase facilities with Modules and Buildings which aren't Shipyards.§!

entries.zh: 训练有素的特工可以传播真相，我们自己的版本，甚至还可以离间最牢固的盟友关系。
entries.en: Skilled operatives can spread our version of the truth, undermining even the friendliest relationships.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n降低[root.target.GetName]与另一个帝国的外交关系。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nLower Relations between the [root.target.GetName] and another empire.

entries.zh: 敲诈和勒索的组合拳可以为我们的外交使节建立有用的影响力。
entries.en: A combination of blackmail and extortion could build useful leverage for our diplomatic envoys.
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nGain at least one Favor from the [root.target.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们的特工能够为目标帝国内的颠覆势力提供无法溯源的武器和舰船，为他们散播混乱和毁灭提供各种方便。
entries.en: Our operatives will provide untraceable weapons and ships to subversive elements within the target empire, giving them the means to spread chaos and destruction.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n使一支敌对的海盗舰队出现在[root.target.GetAdj]的宇域内。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nCause a fleet of hostile Privateers to appear within [root.target.GetAdj] space.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R海盗已经在前往§Y[root.target.GetName]§!的路上。我们必须先等待§Y[Root.Target.target_of_operation_arm_privateers]§!才能够寻找到另一次机会。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RPrivateer activity is already under way in the §Y[root.target.GetName]§!. We must wait until at least §Y[Root.Target.target_of_operation_arm_privateers]§! for another opportunity.§!

entries.zh: 他们说，任何想从恐怖的野兽口中逃脱的人，重要的不是自己跑的有多快，而是和谁一起跑。一些投放在我们目标首都的诱饵或许有助于做到这一点……
entries.en: They say that to escape any rampaging beast, you don't need to outrun it - just whoever you're with. A few tempting lures towards our target's capital ought to help, too...

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n诱骗危机派系的舰队前往[root.target.GetAdj]的首都。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nLure a Crisis faction fleet towards the [root.target.GetAdj] capital.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们必须至少等待§Y4年§!才能再次诱骗危机势力。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RWe must wait at least §Y4 years§! between attempts to lure a Crisis.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们必须至少等待§Y[This.Owner.crisis_beacon_timer]§!才能再次诱骗危机势力。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RWe must wait until at least §Y[This.Owner.crisis_beacon_timer]§! before we may attempt to lure a Crisis again.§!

entries.zh: 我们的特工会针对§Y[This.Target.GetName]§!编纂信息，并在编纂完毕后发送一份§Y情报§!报告。这将会暴露对方的弱点，在一定时间内增加我方的§Y最大渗透等级§!。\n\n指派一名§Y线人§!执行这样的行动可能会有悖于他们的利益。
entries.en: Our operatives will compile information on the §Y[This.Target.GetName]§!, delivering an §YIntel§! report when complete. This will also expose vulnerabilities that will increase our §YMaximum Infiltration Level§! for some time.\n\nAssigning an §YAsset§! to this operation may skew the results towards their interests.

entries.zh: 我们的特工会针对§Y[This.Target.GetName]§!编纂信息，并在编纂完毕后发送一份§Y情报§!报告。这将会暴露对方的弱点，在一定时间内增加我方的§Y最大渗透等级§!。
entries.en: Our operatives will compile information on the §Y[This.Target.GetName]§!, delivering an §YIntel§! report when complete. This will also expose vulnerabilities that will increase our §YMaximum Infiltration Level§! for some time.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n获得[root.target.GetName]的情报和最大渗透等级。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nGain Intel and Maximum Infiltration Level on the [root.target.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们会充分利用两国外交上的薄弱联系，创造两国之间的尴尬。
entries.en: We will seek to cause embarrassment by exploiting the weak links of their diplomatic establishment.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n针对[root.target.GetName]的一名特使制造外交场合的尴尬。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nCause diplomatic embarrassment involving an Envoy of the [root.target.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们的特工会尽一切可能的手段来阻止目标帝国的特使通过游说削弱帝国权威。
entries.en: Our operatives will employ whatever means are necessary to dissuade the target empire's envoys from lobbying to weaken Imperial Authority.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n弱化[root.target.GetName]对于帝国权威削弱的尝试。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nWeaken attempts by the [root.target.GetName] to lower Imperial Authority.

entries.zh: 我们的特工会深入帝国的心脏，削弱星海帝国对星系的掌控力。
entries.en: Our operatives will infiltrate the heart of Imperial society to weaken the Galactic Imperium's grip on the galaxy.

entries.zh: 星海帝国正处在一场公开叛乱的危险边缘。我们的特工将抓住机会竭尽所能来发动一场在全星系范围内反抗帝国专制暴政的起义。\n\n§R当一个时段结束时如果帝国权威回升到§Y80§!以上行动将被取消。§!
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium is hovering on the brink of open revolt. Our operatives will seize this opportunity and do everything in their power to trigger a galaxy-wide rebellion against the Imperium's tyrannical rule.\n\n§RThis operation will be terminated if Imperial Authority is above §Y80§! when a Phase concludes.§!

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n成立义军并向星海帝国宣战。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nForm a Rebellion and declare war against the Galactic Imperium.

此数值反映你的行动在这个阶段出现显著突破的几率。

每当一个行动时段结束，游戏将自动掷出一枚骰子（结果范围为§Y1§!到§Y10§!）。掷骰结果会与§Y技能加成§!和§Y线索§!数相加，随后减去§Y难度§!值。
entries.en:
§H$ARCHAEOLOGICAL_SITE_BREAKTHROUGH$§!
This reflects the chance of your operatives making a breakthrough during the current stage of their Operation.

Every time a phase ends, a die (§Y1§! to §Y10§!) is rolled. The result of the roll is added to §YSkill Bonus§! and §YInsights§!, then subtracted by §YDifficulty§!.

entries.en: ($CHANCE|%0Y$) Result is $MIN|0Y$ or greater. Finishes stage.

entries.en: ($CHANCE|%0Y$) Result is $MAX|0Y$ or less. Adds $CLUES|0Y$ Insights.

entries.zh: §R耗尽§!我方间谍网中的线人会让进度恢复。
entries.en: §RExpending§! our Spy Network Asset will allow progress to resume.

entries.zh: 如果他们的§Y$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§!比我们的§Y$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!要高，他们有可能甄别出我们。
entries.en: They may identify us if their §Y$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§! is superior to our §Y$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!.

entries.zh: 我们的高§Y$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!能力意味着这项研究的推进速度更为迅猛。
entries.en: Our high §Y$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§! capability means this research will advance more quickly.

entries.zh: 心灵感应者可以监视具有错误思想的公民，在对心灵感应技术经过一定的研究之后，他们也可以纠正他们在公民中发现的思想错误。
entries.en: Telepaths can monitor the citizenry for incorrect thoughts, but with some study they could also correct thought aberrations that they find.

entries.zh: 通过进一步的研究，我们的灵能使子个体可以在反常冲动成为意识思维之前将其识别出来，并在必要时纠正这些反常。
entries.en: With additional study, our telepath drones could identify deviant impulses before they emerge as conscious thought, and correct these aberrations as necessary.

entries.zh: 皮下植入体领域的进一步进展使我们可以获悉被植入目标的移动位置和行动。
entries.en: Further advancements in the field of subdermal implants can provide detailed information regarding the movements and actions of the implanted.

entries.zh: 计算机领域的新突破让我们能够有更多新手段保护我的数据免遭窥视。
entries.en: Advances in computing technology have given us new ways to protect our data from prying eyes.

entries.zh: 不稳定纠缠态领域的进一步突破让我们能够有更多新手段保护我们的数据遭受非法入侵。
entries.en: Further advances in unstable entanglement have given us new ways to prevent unauthorized intrusions into our databases.

entries.zh: 我们最近在加密领域发现了一个奇怪的物理学现象，我们能够先输入一个特殊密钥再生成它。
entries.en: Our latest advances in encryption exploit recently discovered quirks of physics to require inputting a specialized key before it has been generated.

entries.zh: 原始的加密机制在现代破译技术面前毫无胜算。
entries.en: Primitive encryption systems stand no chance against modern decryption tools.

entries.zh: 任何安保机制中最脆弱的环节一定是其中的人。通过计算机模拟，我们能够建立他们的弱点模型，从而发现崭新的方法避开他们的安保系统——又或者骗过他们瞒天过海。
entries.en: The weakest link in any security system are the individuals within it. By modeling their weaknesses in computer simulations we can find novel ways to bypass their security - or trick them into bypassing it for us.

entries.zh: 我们的特工可以在临近的现实映射中获取数据，这样就不用冒着在真实现实中触发警报的风险来获取情报。
entries.en: Our operatives can access data from adjacent realities without risking setting off alarms in this reality.

entries.zh: 坚固的合金使我们能够建造预制建筑物，为我们的殖民地提供更好的基础设施。
entries.en: Stronger alloys allow us to create prefabricated buildings, providing our colonies with the improved infrastructure.

entries.zh: 冶金学的进步使我们能够建造更大，更耐用的结构，从而大大改善了殖民地的基础设施。
entries.en: Advances in metallurgy permit us to build vastly larger and more durable structures, greatly improving the infrastructure of our colonies.

entries.zh: 随着我们殖民地的发展，我们的产能将会得到显著提升。
entries.en: As our colonies become more developed, we can gain significant improvements to our throughput.

entries.zh: 人口密度的增加使我们有机会进一步提高生产力。
entries.en: Increased population density gives us an opportunity to further increase productivity.

entries.zh: 技术的不断进步使我们最发达的星球达到了前所未有的生产力水平。
entries.en: Continued advancements in technology allow our most developed planets to reach productivity levels unheard of in earlier times.

entries.zh: 可怕的威胁对我们虎视眈眈，等待着我们放松警惕的一刻。更多的资源必须被投入到内部秘密安全部门以更好地自我保护。
entries.en: Terrible threats probe our defenses, waiting for us to lower our guard. Increased resources must be sent to internal covert security departments to protect ourselves.

entries.zh: 拓展我们的情报行动，优先发展解码科技对我们帝国的福祉至关重要。
entries.en: Expanding our intelligence operations and prioritizing decryption technologies is critical for the well-being of the empire.

entries.zh: 额外的资源将用于协助拓展我们的观测能力。
entries.en: Additional resources will be directed to nurturing and expanding our observation capabilities.

entries.zh: 相当一部分处理能力将被划拨到调查分析领域。
entries.en: A substantial portion of processing power will be diverted to investigative analysis.

entries.zh: 通过强制皮下植入来监控移动和行动可以大幅度增强我们帝国的内部安全。忠诚的公民不应对政府有任何隐瞒。
entries.en: Mandatory subdermal implants record movement and actions, greatly enhancing our empire's internal security. Loyal citizens have nothing to hide from the government.

entries.zh: 心灵感应者可以监视具有错误思想的公民，并能在发现时及时纠正。
entries.en: Telepaths monitoring the citizenry for incorrect thoughts will make corrections as they find them.

entries.zh:
加密：§G+1§!
幸福度：§R-10%§!
主流思潮吸引力：§G+25%§!
$job_telepath_plural$提供§G-30§!犯罪度
灵能使子个体监督着我们集体思维中的反常冲动，在成为有意识的思想之前纠正偏差。
entries.en: Telepath drones monitor our collective mind for deviant impulses, correcting aberrations before they emerge as conscious thought.

entries.zh: 通过增加维护子个体的突触连接，它们为周围子个体提供支持的能力得以提升。
entries.en: By increasing the synaptic links of our maintenance drones, their ability to provide for nearby drones is improved.

entries.zh: 每个§Y$building_hive_node$§!将会得到1个§Y[maintenance_drone.GetName]§!岗位，但是维护费将会提升£energy£§R+2§!。
entries.en: §Y$building_hive_node$§! gain 1 §Y[maintenance_drone.GetName]§! job but their upkeep is increased by £energy£ §R+2§!.

entries.zh: 工业维护子个体被授权充当每个区划周围地区的监管人。
entries.en: Industrial maintenance drones are empowered to act as caretakers for the areas surrounding each district.

entries.zh: 每个§Y$district_industrial_plural$§!将会得到1个§Y[maintenance_drone.GetName]§!岗位，但是维护费将会提升£energy£§R+2§!。
entries.en: §Y$district_industrial_plural$§! gain 1 §Y[maintenance_drone.GetName]§! job but their upkeep is increased by £energy£ §R+2§!.

entries.zh: 一个心怀不满的官僚，被一个美好生活的虚假承诺引诱到而服务于我们。
entries.en: A disgruntled bureaucrat that has been lured into our service through false promises of a better life.

entries.zh: 一名不满足于自己工作的普通业务员，渴望生活中有些波澜。
entries.en: A common clerk unhappy with their job, eager for a little excitement in their life.

entries.zh: 一位接受贿赂并现在通过勒索保持联系的经济学家。
entries.en: An economist that accepted a bribe and is now kept in line through blackmail.

entries.zh: 我们对这位科学家的骄傲投其所好，这使他们确信，自己的母国对他们的重视程度不高。
entries.en: Our appeals to this scientist's pride have convinced them that they are under-appreciated by their home empire.

entries.zh: 被上级漠视的军官。我们给了他们他们想要的认可。
entries.en: A military officer that has been spurned by their superiors. We have given them the recognition they desire.

entries.zh: 一个在同行眼里可有可无的小罪犯。我们的特工针对他们的贪婪和自负发动了攻势。
entries.en: A petty criminal disrespected by their peers. Our operatives have appealed to their sense of greed and self-importance.

entries.zh: 一名一知半解的小卒，为外交部门的一个小办公处服务。他们愿意分享一些不应分享的信息。
entries.en: An unwitting pawn that works as a minor diplomatic functionary. They are all too willing to share information that they should not.

entries.zh: 在叛乱浪潮中的一名被深重压迫剥削的人。
entries.en: An overlooked and overworked member of society with a rebellious streak.

entries.zh: 被他们母国通缉的高超黑客。现在他为我们工作以换取报酬和保护。
entries.en: A skilled hacker that is wanted by their home empire. They work for us for pay and protection.

entries.zh: 一名专门从事获取军事物品的罪犯。
entries.en: A criminal that specializes in the acquisition of military goods.

entries.zh: 天真的乐观主义者，深信自己可以使世界变得更好。支持他们的观点可以非常容易地控制他们。
entries.en: A naive optimist that believes they can change the world for the better. Very easy to control by appealing to their cause.

entries.zh: 媒体上有同情心的声音，愿意传播我们的信息以交换信息。
entries.en: A sympathetic voice in the media, willing to spread our message in exchange for information.

entries.zh: 一名早就过了气的娱乐明星，他现在愿意为了重回聚光灯下做出任何事情。
entries.en: An entertainment figure that has used up their fifteen minutes of fame and is willing to do absolutely anything to return to the spotlight.

entries.zh: 一位名誉扫地的学者正在寻找一种方法来赎回他们的名字。
entries.en: A discredited scholar looking for a way to redeem their name.

entries.zh: 一名受伤的退伍军人，深陷于官僚主义的扯皮中。我们来帮助他们。
entries.en: An injured war veteran that was lost in the wheels of bureaucracy. We came to their aid.

entries.zh: 若能对对手进行解剖研究并获得第一手的官能资料，这将对我们的谍报行动提供各方各面的益处。
entries.en: Hands-on knowledge of the functioning of our adversaries' anatomy can be remarkably useful during all manner of espionage operations.

entries.zh: 特工可以利用这个反常的突触子个体来接收蜂巢思维的思想。
entries.en: Operatives can use this deviant synapse drone to receive thoughts from the hive.

entries.zh: 这个畸形的突触递质可以用来改变蜂巢接收到的信息。
entries.en: This malformed ephapse relay can be used to alter messages received by the hive.

entries.zh: 对这一子个体的修改允许我们的操作者给它下达简单的命令。
entries.en: Alterations made to this worker drone allow our operatives to give it simple commands.

entries.zh: 微小的变异使得这架研究子个体与蜂群思维的连接比以往更不安全。
entries.en: Minor mutations have caused this research drone's connection to the hive mind to be less secure than usual.

entries.zh: 我们的特工设法找到了一种方法来给这个作战子个体下达服务于我们的命令。
entries.en: Our operatives have managed to find a means of giving this warrior drone commands which serve our goals.

entries.zh: 作为蜂巢思维防御系统的一部分，这个子个体可以识别出不正常的子个体并破坏它们。然而，这个子个体已经为我们所用了。
entries.en: Part of the hive's defense systems, this object identifies deviant drones for destruction. Conveniently, this one has been subverted.

entries.zh: 这个信息素输出者会影响周围所有子个体。
entries.en: This Pheromone Emitter affects the behavior of all nearby drones.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维的资源分配是由资源分配节点组成的网络来处理的。
entries.en: The hive's allocation of resources is handled by a network of resource distribution nodes.

entries.zh: 作为蜂巢的数据存储，控制一个皮层节点可以让我们的特工窃取或修改数据。
entries.en: Acting as data storage for the hive, control of a cortex node can allow our operatives to steal or modify data.

entries.zh: 当蜂巢的舰队穿行于星系之间时，这些卷须用于相互沟通。
entries.en: These tendrils are used for communication with the hive's fleets across the galaxy.

entries.zh: 该系统充当行星主要节点和该区域[coordinator.GetName]子个体的中间层。
entries.en: This system acts as a layer between a planet's primary nodes and the [coordinator.GetName] drones for that area.

entries.zh: 与其他智慧的通讯大部分被这个系统处理。
entries.en: Communication with other intelligences is largely governed by this system.

entries.zh: 通过物流系统，可以追踪当地资源。
entries.en: Tracking of local resources is handled through the logistics system.

entries.zh: 这个数据库追踪一颗行星的研究设施的进展和需要。
entries.en: This database tracks both the progress and needs of the research facilities of a planet.

entries.zh: 这个系统包含了作战计划和无数局部地区潜在冲突的模拟。
entries.en: This system contains battle plans and countless simulations of potential conflict within the local area.

entries.zh: 一个中继器，它将来自其他系统的命令转发给给定区域内的无人机。
entries.en: A compromised relay that forwards commands from other systems to drones within a given area.

entries.zh: 该上行链路用于在节点之间长距离传送命令。
entries.en: This uplink is intended to send orders across long distances between nodes.

entries.zh: 资源聚集在这些桥塔上进行分配。
entries.en: Resources are gathered at these pylons for distribution.

entries.zh: 本地的研究资料在传送给主要情报机构之前，先储存在这些系统中。
entries.en: Local research is stored in these systems before being forwarded to the primary intelligence.

entries.zh: 我们的特工找到了一个弱点，使他们能够部分控制一个防御性武器阵地。
entries.en: Our operatives have exploited a vulnerability which allows them to take partial control of a defensive weapons emplacement.

entries.zh: 我们的特工已经完成了情报收集行动，并发送回来一封内容翔实的报告，涵盖他们发现的所有信息。
entries.en: Our operatives have completed their information-gathering operation and have sent a dossier detailing their findings.

entries.zh:
谍报行动$NAME|H$
目标：$TARGET|Y$
进度：$PROGRESS|Y%0$
下次掷骰：£time£ $NEXT_ROLL|Y$
我们将在$DAYS|Y$天后达到下一等级。
entries.en: We will reach the next Level in $DAYS|Y$ days.

entries.zh: §E§Y渗透等级§!决定当前间谍网可以执行什么样的行动，同时还能增加我们对这个帝国持有的§Y情报§!。\n\n随着渗透等级提升，你的特工们需要花费更长的时间来拓展间谍网。§!
entries.en: §E§YInfiltration Level§! determines what Operations this Spy Network can perform and may increase the §YIntel§! we have of this Empire.\n\nAs Infiltration Level increases, it takes your operatives longer to further expand the Spy Network.§!

entries.zh: $INFILTRATION_LEVEL_DELAYED_BODY$\n\n§E间谍网具有一个§Y最大渗透等级§!，其数值与帝国的§Y相对加密§!，§Y国民理念§!以及§Y可用线人§!密切相关。§!
entries.en: $INFILTRATION_LEVEL_DELAYED_BODY$\n\n§ESpy Networks have a §YMaximum Infiltration Level§! which is heavily modified by §YRelative Encryption§!, §YCivics§!, and by §YAcquiring Assets§! within an Empire.§!

entries.zh: $INFILTRATION_LEVEL_DELAYED_BODY$\n\n§E间谍网具有一个§Y最大渗透等级§!，其数值与帝国的§Y相对加密§!和§Y国民理念§!密切相关。§!
entries.en: $INFILTRATION_LEVEL_DELAYED_BODY$\n\n§ESpy Networks have a §YMaximum Infiltration Level§! which is heavily modified by §YRelative Encryption§! and §YCivics§!.§!

entries.zh: §E§Y线人§!是能对某些行动发挥作用的特工，并且在执行某些特殊种类的行动时提供一定的加成。有时当行动暴露后，你可以通过牺牲线人来掩盖你的行踪。§!
entries.en: §E§YAssets§! are operatives that could prove useful for certain operations, and grant bonuses related to specific operation types. Assets can sometimes be sacrificed to cover your tracks, should an operation be exposed.§!

entries.zh:
§H无线人§!
§R没有可用的线人。§!

线人可通过§Y招募线人§!行动或是事件来获取。
entries.en:
§HNo Asset§!
§RThere are no available assets.§!

Assets are gained through the §YAcquire Asset§! operation, or through events.

entries.zh: §E我们的§Y相对加密§!决定我们对目标解码的难易程度。§!
entries.en: §EOur §YRelative Encryption§! determines how difficult it is for us to break the codes of our target.§!

entries.zh: §H行动花费§!\n执行该项行动的一次性花费。
entries.en: §HOperation Cost§!\nOne-time cost to run this operation.

entries.zh: §H准备就绪后自动执行§!\n一旦你的特工完成了所有准备工作，他们将自动执行行动而无需等待确认。
entries.en: §HCommence When Ready§!\nOnce your operatives have completed their preparations, they will automatically commence the operation without waiting for confirmation.

entries.zh: §R在行动进行过程中无法指派或移除特使。§!
entries.en: §RCannot assign or remove an Envoy during an ongoing Operation.§!

entries.zh: 我们的特工正在列出处于§H[root.target.GetName]§!境内有潜力成为卧底的人。他们希望能将这些卧底安插到合适的岗位，让他们平日看起来无伤大雅，却能在相当长的时间里随时做好进攻准备。
entries.en: Our operatives are drawing up a shortlist of potential sleeper cells within the §H[root.target.GetName]§!. They hope to find a set of suitable positions where agents may appear innocuous and yet remain poised to strike for a prolonged period of time.

entries.zh: 一系列目标已被确定，我们的特工已经悄悄潜入就位。他们一收到我们的信号就会开始进行策反。
entries.en: A list of targets has been finalized and our operatives have been quietly drifting their way into position. They await our signal to begin establishing sleeper cells.

entries.zh: 来自§H行动[This.GetName]§!的汇报显示，目前为止一切顺利：
entries.en: Reports from §HOperation [This.GetName]§! are favorable so far:

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$我们的密探已经成功藏身于[root.target.GetAdj]社会的各个角落，混迹于不起眼的地方，假装自己只是一名普通的百姓。$operation.8002.desc.end$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ our operatives have successfully concealed themselves in a variety of positions across [root.target.GetAdj] society, hiding in plain site and pretending to simply be ordinary citizens. $operation.8002.desc.end$

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$大量神秘且无迹可查的现金涌入，使我们的密探拥有了强大的财力以及伪造的介绍信，从而可以得到许多领先的[root.target.GetAdj]公司的中层职位。$operation.8002.desc.end$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ an influx of mysterious, untraceable credits has allowed our operatives the financial clout - and falsified references - necessary to walk into mid-level positions in many of the leading [root.target.GetAdj] corporations. $operation.8002.desc.end$

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$神秘且无迹可查的现金涌入，使我们的密探拥有了强大的财力以及伪造的介绍信，从而可以步入领导[root.target.GetAdj]寰宇企业的一些中层职位。$operation.8002.desc.end$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ an influx of mysterious, untraceable credits has allowed our operatives the financial clout - and falsified references - necessary to walk into several mid-level positions within the [root.target.GetAdj] megacorporation. $operation.8002.desc.end$

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$尽管学习足够有关[root.target.GetAdj]宗教的知识是一项巨大的挑战，但我们的特工还是成功被准许加入他们的神职机构了，这可是[root.target.GetGovernmentName]中最有影响力的机构。$operation.8002.desc.end$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ though building up sufficient knowledge of [root.target.GetAdj] spirituality was a significant challenge, our operatives have been admitted within their priesthood - the most influential institution within the [root.target.GetGovernmentName]. $operation.8002.desc.end$

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$在发表诸多虚伪的效忠誓言，外加写上大量伪造的背景调查后，我们的特工在对方皇室的政府体系中谋得了一份官职。$operation.8002.desc.end$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ after many false protestations of fealty - not to mention a plethora of faked background checks - our operatives have settled into bureaucratic positions within the governing structure of the royal family. $operation.8002.desc.end$

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$在发表诸多虚伪的效忠宣誓，外加写上大量伪造的背景调查后，我们的特工终于在其执政党的政府体系中谋得了一份官职。$operation.8002.desc.end$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ after many false protestations of fealty - not to mention a plethora of faked background checks - our operatives have settled into bureaucratic positions within the governing structure of the ruling party. $operation.8002.desc.end$

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$在我们使尽浑身解数，外加大量而小心的掩饰后，我们终于设法将一批特工安插在了[root.target.GetAdj]军队中的低阶军官的位置上。$operation.8002.desc.end$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ after considerable effort, and numerous carefully concealed falsifications, we have managed to plant a number of operatives in low-level officer positions within the [root.target.GetAdj] military. $operation.8002.desc.end$

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$通过最新的信息素技术，我们利用大量的神经阻断剂，设法在[root.target.GetGovernmentName]网络的内部构建了数个\"盲区\"。这样一来，我们就能将特工隐藏起来并开始策反[root.target.GetAdj][root.target.GetIndividualNamePlural]。$operation.8002.desc.end$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ using the latest pheromonal technologies, along with a hearty dose of nerve blockers, we have managed to create several 'blind spots' within the [root.target.GetGovernmentName]. There, we will be able to conceal operatives and begin subverting [root.target.GetAdj] [root.target.GetIndividualNamePlural]. $operation.8002.desc.end$

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$我们设法在[root.target.GetAdj][root.target.GetGestaltEntityName]的内部策反了数个思维个体，这样他们就可以一边偷偷向我们传递信息一边假装仍旧正常工作了。$operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ we have managed to subvert several thought routines within the [root.target.GetAdj] [root.target.GetGestaltEntityName] so that they covertly report to us while pretending to still function as normal. $operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$我们的骇入专家启用了一批位于[root.target.GetGovernmentName]系统内部的隐藏后门，并将其成功埋入[root.target.GetAdj]赖以运作的代码中鲜有人知却又重要的部分。$operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ our expert hackers have opened a number of hidden backdoors in the [root.target.GetGovernmentName], successfully hiding them in obscure yet important segments of the [root.target.GetAdj] code that they rely upon to function. $operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$

entries.zh: $operation.8002.desc.start$我们的骇入子例程启用了一批位于[root.target.GetGovernmentName]系统内部的隐藏后门，并将其成功埋入[root.target.GetAdj]赖以运作的代码中鲜有人知却又重要的部分。$operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$
entries.en: $operation.8002.desc.start$ our subversive subroutines have opened a number of hidden backdoors in the [root.target.GetGovernmentName], successfully hiding them in obscure yet important segments of the [root.target.GetAdj] code that they rely upon to function. $operation.8002.desc.end.gestalt$

entries.zh: \n\n从现在开始，他们将能够向我们汇报[root.target.GetName]的§H最新进展§!，并确保我们具有组织行动的§H长期能力§!，如果我们想要组织的话。
entries.en: \n\nFrom there, they will be able to update us on the §Hlatest happenings§! in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our §Hlong-term ability§! to conduct operations there, should we wish it.

entries.zh: \n\n通过这些，我们能够即时了解[root.target.GetName]的§H最新进展§!，并确保我们具有组织行动的§H长期能力§!，如果我们想要组织的话。
entries.en: \n\nUsing these, we will be able to keep up to date on the §Hlatest happenings§! in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our §Hlong-term ability§! to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
We can go even further than this.

entries.zh: 我们已经成功布下能向我们提供最新消息的卧底，他们将会时刻准备好遵照我们的吩咐行事。
entries.en: We have planted sleeper cells that keep us up to date with the latest affairs and stand ready to do our bidding at a moment's notice.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们已经成功策动位于[root.target.GetName]的卧底。他们将会持续到§Y[Root.sleeper_cell_success]§!§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RWe have already established sleeper cells within the [root.target.GetName]. They will last until §Y[Root.sleeper_cell_success]§!§!

entries.zh: 星海共同体中夹杂着一阵不和谐的杂音，不是所有人都很友好，肯定地说这其中必有与[Root.GetAdj]利益不一致的人。不妙的是，使者[event_envoy.GetName]似乎正在听取某种错误的声音。在参加由§H[Root.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]§!主办的几场会议中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]的眉毛止不住地上翘。现在一切都水落石出了，一笔可以追溯到某个组织的巨款被查明汇入了[event_envoy.GetHerHim]的账户。\n\n[event_envoy.GetName]的同事们要求将[event_envoy.GetSheHe]召回并发起不信任议案。然而，某些更为狡诈的顾问建议我们和[event_envoy.GetHerHim]达成一笔交易，维持其现有职位以换取获得情报的机会。
entries.en: A cacophony of voices may be heard in the Galactic Community - not all of them friendly, and certainly not all of them aligning with [Root.GetAdj] interests. Unfortunately, it seems that emissary [event_envoy.GetName] has been listening to the wrong voices. Eyebrows were raised when [event_envoy.GetSheHe] attended several conferences hosted by the §H[Root.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]§!. Now it has emerged that a large sum of credits traceable to that organization were transferred to [event_envoy.GetHerHim].\n\n[event_envoy.GetName]'s colleagues demand that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] be recalled, citing trust issues. However, some of our more devious advisors suggest that we could strike a deal to keep [event_envoy.GetHerHim] in place in return for a share of the pot.
What could be the harm in it?

entries.zh: 我们的特使似乎因为某些说客团体的献金而富了起来，不过他们依然在为我方谋利益。
entries.en: Our envoys are as likely to enrich themselves with funds from lobbyist groups as they are to actually do our bidding.
Movement for Sane and Prudent Relations between Species
Organization for the Facilitation of Trickle-Down Economics

entries.zh: [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对我方[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot]，[event_envoy.GetName]，在[event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]的所作所为表达了深切的不满。显然[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的行为冒犯了当地的[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，政府机构不得不派出护卫来保证[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的个人安全。由于我们缺乏[envoy_country.GetAdj]的那种多愁善感，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]具体做了什么还不得而知，但是在[event_envoy.GetSheHe]预计要演讲的地方，出现了大量的反对[event_envoy.GetHerHim]本人以及反对“[Root.GetAdj]的傲慢无礼”的抗议活动。\n\n[envoy_country.GetName]勒令我方召回[event_envoy.GetName]，并派遣一名新的大使替代[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的职位。他们暗示，如果我方拒绝，会造成外交后果。
entries.en: The [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have brought forward a complaint regarding the conduct of our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation], [event_envoy.GetName]. Apparently [event_envoy.GetHerHis] conduct has so offended the local [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that their authorities have posted a guard for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] own protection. Exactly what [event_envoy.GetSheHe] did is unclear to us, as we lack [envoy_country.GetAdj] sensibilities, but there are widespread protests against [event_envoy.GetHerHim] and the "[Root.GetAdj] arrogance" [event_envoy.GetSheHe] supposedly represent[event_envoy.GetSXX].\n\nThe [envoy_country.GetName] urges us to recall [event_envoy.GetName] and send a new ambassador in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] place. They hint at diplomatic repercussions should we refuse.

entries.zh: 异星人的矫揉造作跟我们没关系。
entries.en: Alien sensibilities do not matter to us.

entries.zh: [This.GetName]缺乏性格，无法深陷丑闻之中
entries.en: The [This.GetName] lacks enough personality to become involved in scandals

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ [Root.Target.GetName]已经身陷丑闻之中。\n我们需要§Y[Root.operation_diplomatic_incident_timer]§!后才能才次尝试
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$The [Root.Target.GetName] have been saturated with scandals.\nWe may try again after §Y[Root.operation_diplomatic_incident_timer]§!

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]的外交团听闻[scandal_empire.GetName]最新报道的新闻之后举团震惊。我们一直驻留在当地的[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot][event_envoy.GetName]，让[event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself]陷入了严重的[scandal_empire.GetAdj]法律纠纷。[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]目前深陷一场桃色事件，涉及到了一连串极其严重的罪行，甚至还牵涉到一场极其残忍的双人谋杀。\n\n随着局势发展——当然谣言已经在[scandal_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]人群间满天飞——看上去[event_envoy.GetName]的罪行已经板上钉钉了。[scandal_empire.GetAdj]当局要求撤销[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的外交豁免权，这样[event_envoy.GetSheHe]就能因为[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的所作所为接受法律与正义的审判。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAdj] diplomatic corps has been shaken by the news emerging from the [scandal_empire.GetName]. Our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] [event_envoy.GetName], who had been stationed there, has gotten [event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself] into a serious mess with [scandal_empire.GetAdj] law enforcement. [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] [event_envoy.GetIsAre] currently in connection with a salacious affair involving an astonishing range of serious crimes that culminated in a brutal double murder.\n\nAs matters stand - and with rumors running wild among the [scandal_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - there seems little doubt as to [event_envoy.GetName]'s guilt. The [scandal_empire.GetAdj] authorities have requested that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] diplomatic immunity be lifted so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can face justice for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] deeds.

entries.zh: 刚一进入[Root.envoy_location_country.GetName]，大使[Root.GetName]就因为一连串数不清的违法行为被逮捕。[Root.envoy_location_country.GetAdj]的公函十分简洁：“我方感谢你方将罪犯转交，正义得以伸张。”
entries.en: Upon entering the [Root.envoy_location_country.GetName], Ambassador [Root.GetName] was arrested on numerous charges of wrongdoing. The [Root.envoy_location_country.GetAdj] missive was brief: "we thank you for returning the criminal to us, so that justice may be served."

entries.zh: 我们的特工正在对§H[Root.Target.GetName]§!国内的数名关键外交要员进行投资，希望能够找到把柄以备未来之用。
entries.en: Our operatives are investigating key diplomatic actors within the §H[Root.Target.GetName]§!, searching for hooks which we may be able to exploit.

entries.zh: 我们在§H[Root.Target.GetAdj]§!的外交官僚机构中已经筛选出了一批有丑闻潜质的子个体。其中几个的潜在丑闻已经被我方发现，我们的特工正在竭尽全力，确保事情能朝我们希冀的方向发展。
entries.en: We have drawn up a list of potentially scandal-prone figures within the §H[Root.Target.GetAdj]§! diplomatic bureaucracy. Several potential leads have been found, and our operatives are working hard to find the best means by which to manufacture the desired outcome.

entries.zh: 已经为§H[This.GetName]行动§!甄别出了一名合适的目标，已经为其取出了详细的宗卷档案。我们的特工静候命令，随时准备散布丑闻。
entries.en: A suitable target for §HOperation [This.GetName]§! has been identified, and an extensive dossier has been drawn up. Our operatives wait on our word to trigger the scandal.

entries.zh: 我们位于§H[Root.Target.GetName]§!的特工带回了坏消息：他们目前尚无法为§H[This.GetName]行动§!甄选出一名合适的目标。显然[Root.Target.GetGovernmentName]对于丑闻的耐受性特别强，我们挖掘到的任何污点都没法在公众间掀起波澜。
entries.en: Our agents in the §H[Root.Target.GetName]§! bring ill tidings: they were not able to find a suitable target for §HOperation [This.GetName]§!. Apparently the [Root.Target.GetGovernmentName] is sufficiently scandal-torn that any dirt we discovered on them would hardly have raised a stir.

entries.zh: 我们位于§H[Root.Target.GetName]§!的特工带回了坏消息：尽管做了各方面的准备，特工们重点关注的目标并没有上钩，因此他们也没法捏造什么丑闻。虽然听上去有点难以置信，但是[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交使团竟然真的挖不出一丁点黑料。
entries.en: Our agents in the §H[Root.Target.GetName]§! bring ill tidings: despite extensive preparation, their apparently promising target did not fall for the bait, and they were unable to manufacture a scandal. Incredible as it may seem, it appears that there simply aren't any bad apples within the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic corps at the moment.

entries.zh: 我们位于§H[Root.Target.GetName]§!的特工报告，§H[This.GetName]行动§!获得了广泛的成功：
entries.en: Our agents in the §H[Root.Target.GetName]§! report that §HOperation [This.GetName]§! was a resounding success:

entries.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$经过一次大胆的行动，我们设法陷害了对方一名驻§H[offended_party.GetName]§!的特使，使其罪名缠身。这一事件让他们感到非常尴尬，并导致他们同[offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的关系变得十分紧张。结果，该国的§H外交立场§!被削弱了。
entries.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ in a bold move, we were able to frame one of their envoys to the §H[offended_party.GetName]§! for a surprisingly wide range of crimes. The affair has caused them considerable embarrassment and strained their relations with the [offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Their §Hdiplomatic standing§! is weakened as a result.

entries.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$经过一次大胆的行动，我们设法让对方驻扎在§H我们帝国§!的一名特使深陷一系列范围极其广泛的罪行中。这件事使他们相当尴尬，我们假意的冒犯在很大程度上加剧了他们的尴尬。结果，该国的§H外交立场§!被削弱了。
entries.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ in a bold feint, we were able to frame one of their envoys to §Hour own empire§! for a surprisingly wide range of crimes. The affair has caused them considerable embarrassment, exaggerated in no small part by the offense we have pretended to take. Their §Hdiplomatic standing§! is weakened as a result.

entries.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$经过一些巧妙的运作，我们成功抹黑了[Root.Target.GetAdj]同§H[offended_party.GetName]§!的关系。他们的一名特使踏入了我们精心设下的圈套，不经意间吐露了他们对同行的真实看法，令外界所不耻。结果，该国的§H外交立场§!被削弱了。
entries.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ through some clever manipulation, we have managed to tarnish [Root.Target.GetAdj] relations with the §H[offended_party.GetName]§!. One of their envoys took the bait we carefully set up for them, and accidentally publicly revealed their true thoughts - which proved to be deliciously unsavory - about their counterparts. Their §Hdiplomatic standing§! is weakened as a result.

entries.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$经过一些巧妙的运作，我们成功地抹黑了[Root.Target.GetAdj]同§H我们自己国家§!的关系。他们的一名特使踏入了我们精心设下的圈套，不经意间把自己对我国外交官的看法——外界看来这是非常不明智的——吐露了出来。结果，[Root.Target.GetAdj]的§H外交立场§!被削弱了。
entries.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ through some clever manipulation, we have managed to tarnish [Root.Target.GetAdj] relations with §Hour own empire§!. One of their envoys took the bait we carefully set up for them, and was tricked into publicly revealing some deliciously unsavory, private thoughts about our own diplomats. [Root.Target.GetAdj] §Hdiplomatic standing§! is weakened as a result.

entries.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$通过把某位特使压下去的失足行为公之于众，我们成功地让他们陷入了空前的尴尬。结果，该国的§H外交立场§!被削弱了。
entries.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ by bringing to light some mortifying missteps by one of their envoys, we have managed to cause the them considerable embarrassment. Their §Hdiplomatic standing§! is weakened as a result.

entries.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$我们成功曝光了一场游说丑闻。我们匿名举报，揭发他们在星海共同体工作的一位特使，是如何受贿为§H[Root.Target.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]§!讲话的，而该组织与[Root.Target.GetAdj]的利益截然相反。结果，该国的§H外交立场§!被削弱了。
entries.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ we were able to spark a lobbying scandal. All that was needed was an anonymous tip-off detailing exactly how much one of their envoys to the Galactic Community was being paid to represent the §H[Root.Target.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]§! - an organization diametrically opposed to [Root.Target.GetAdj] interests. Their §Hdiplomatic standing§! is weakened as a result.

entries.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$看来他们的一名特使和异星人坠入了爱河——这对该物种来说是严重的罪行。经过循循诱导，我们帮助其避开了[Root.Target.GetAdj]的安保队，并成功地劝说他们和伴侣私奔到一个更加开放包容的社会。\n\n这一事件造成了一系列公开的§H令人不适的质疑§!，并将[Root.Target.GetGovernmentName]置于艰难的外交境地。
entries.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ it turned out that one of their envoys had fallen in love with a xeno - a grave offense among their kind. With some gentle persuasion - and our help with evading [Root.Target.GetAdj] security forces - we were able to persuade them to elope with their partner and seek refuge in a more tolerant society.\n\nThis incident has brought §Huncomfortable questions§! to the fore and put the [Root.Target.GetGovernmentName] in a difficult diplomatic situation.

entries.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$以一些温和的劝说和对录音装置的巧妙利用，我们成功地曝光了他们的一名特使与[Root.Target.GetAdj]所指定的标准有多巨大的偏差。\n\n这一事件造成了一系列公开的§H令人不适的质疑§!，并且让[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交立场变得十分艰难。
entries.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ with some gentle persuasion - and clever use of recording equipment - we were able to expose just how far one of their envoys had drifted from [Root.Target.GetAdj] norms on their assignment.\n\nThis incident has brought §Huncomfortable questions§! to the fore and put the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic corps in a difficult situation.

entries.zh: $operation.8230.desc.base$他们一位特使的药物滥用行为被公之于众，使得一些声名狼藉的毒枭对他们的决策能力施加了不当影响。结果，该国的§H外交立场§!被削弱了。
entries.en: $operation.8230.desc.base$ the matter was resolved by bringing to light one of their envoys' substance abuse, which had allowed malevolent drug lords undue influence over their decisions. Their §Hdiplomatic standing§! is weakened as a result.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.Target.GetName]§!外交使团的可信度变得支离破碎了。
entries.en: The credibility of the §Y[Root.Target.GetName]§!'s diplomatic corps lies in tatters.

entries.zh: [event_envoy.GetName]，我们派遣到[envoy_country.GetName]的特使，似乎有些被他们同化了。
entries.en: [event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native.

entries.zh: 这一发现促使人们动议将[event_envoy.GetHerHim]召回，使[event_envoy.GetSheHe]能够回归到正统的[Root.GetAdj]行为准则上。然而，另一种观点则认为，拥有一位与能够理解与我们差异巨大的对手的外交人员在紧张的外交局势中将会有好处。
entries.en: These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.

entries.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$在过去的几个月中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]经常表达对[envoy_country.GetAdj]国家体制的赞美，与[Root.GetGovernmentName]内的僵化和缺乏自由形成了鲜明的对比。
“我亲眼可见他们的政府在倾听人民的呼声，”据传[event_envoy.GetSheHe]最近有说道。“事实上，我自己很难想象出一个更好的体制了。”

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
entries.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ Over the last few months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] often seemed to admire the [envoy_country.GetAdj] governmental system, favorably contrasting the liberties enjoyed there with the rigidity and lack of freedom within the [Root.GetGovernmentName].
"I can well see the appeal of delegating government to the People," [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetWasWere] recently heard to say. "In fact, I could scarcely imagine a better system myself."

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

entries.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$在过去的几个月中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]经常表达对[envoy_country.GetAdj]国家体制的赞美，与[Root.GetGovernmentName]内的优柔寡断形成鲜明的对比。
“如果高效率政府的代价仅仅是一点点的自由，也许这个代价是可以接受的，”据传[event_envoy.GetSheHe]最近这么说道过。

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
entries.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ Over the last few months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] often seemed to admire the [envoy_country.GetAdj] governmental system, complaining frequently at the relative indecision of our [Root.GetGovernmentName].
"If lesser liberty is the price of an efficient government, then perhaps that is a price worth paying," [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetWasWere] recently heard to say.

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

entries.zh: $envoy_events.210.desc.start$怪异的是，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]已接受了[envoy_country.GetAdj]对外星人的不信任，呼吁采取措施防止[Root.GetAdj]对异种殷勤好客的滥用。受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]回答说，在[envoy_country.Capital.GetName]中看到了更井井有条的社会的好处后，要回到混乱和无法无天的[Root.Capital.GetName]确实有点困难。\n\n$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
entries.en: $envoy_events.210.desc.start$ Bizarrely, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] taken to agreeing with [envoy_country.GetAdj] distrust of the alien, calling for measures to prevent alleged xeno exploitation of [Root.GetAdj] hospitality. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] responded that, having seen the benefits of a more orderly society in [envoy_country.Capital.GetName], returning to the chaos and lawlessness of [Root.Capital.GetName] would be difficult indeed.\n\n$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

entries.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$[event_envoy.GetSheHe]放弃了[Root.GetAdj]对外星人的不信任，并通过肆意参加[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的狂欢来满足[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原始的肉欲。当受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]回复道：
“我怎么才能拒绝美丽的[envoy_country.GetSpeciesAdj][envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]呢？”

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
entries.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ Abandoning [Root.GetAdj] distrust of the alien, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] been caught satisfying [event_envoy.GetHerHis] carnal lusts by participating in orgies with a multitude of [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] commented:
"How could I possibly resist the beautiful [envoy_country.GetSpeciesAdj] [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]?"

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

entries.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$令人不安的是，[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]似乎接纳了[envoy_country.GetAdj]的唯心论，抛弃了[Root.GetAdj]对这些玩意的怀疑主义。当受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]辩护道：
“当圣喻昭显于我时，我又如何能质疑它呢？”

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
entries.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] seem[event_envoy.GetSXX] disturbingly taken in by [envoy_country.GetAdj] spirituality, eschewing [Root.GetAdj] skepticism in such matters. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] protested:
"How can I doubt divine truth when all has become clear to me?"

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

entries.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]似乎对我们人民对神圣事务的信仰嗤之以鼻，并对[envoy_country.GetAdj]的意识形态愈发赞同，包括个人财富的积累和允许人工智能自由等。当受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]回击道：
“我们[Root.GetName]已经沉浸在过去许久，是时候拥抱未来了。”

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
entries.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] seem[event_envoy.GetSXX] almost scornful of our people's attitude to divine matters, increasingly voicing sympathy to the [envoy_country.GetAdj] outlook on matters ranging from the accumulation of personal wealth to the permissibility of unshackled AIs. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] hit back:
"We have for too long lived in the past, here in the [Root.GetName]. It is time we embrace the future."

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

entries.zh: $envoy_events.210.desc.start$[event_envoy.GetSheHe]放弃了[Root.GetAdj]的和平主义，并已成为坚决主张增加军费和进攻性外交政策的倡导者，并公开赞扬[envoy_country.GetAdj]军国主义。\n\n$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
entries.en: $envoy_events.210.desc.start$ Abandoning [Root.GetAdj] pacifism, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] become a remarkably strident advocate for greater military spending and a more proactive foreign policy, openly praising [envoy_country.GetAdj] militarism.\n\n$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

entries.zh:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$在最近的几个月里，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]愈发对[Root.GetAdj]的军国主义言辞犀利，赞扬“更加善良”的[envoy_country.GetAdj]处事方式。当受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]回击道：
“我们不能永远在星系中扮演残暴的野蛮人。要想更多的文明人赞扬我们，我们就必须控制而我们的本能。”

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$
entries.en:
$envoy_events.210.desc.start$ In recent months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] become increasingly critical of [Root.GetAdj] militarism, praising the "more virtuous" [envoy_country.GetAdj] existence. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] hit back:
"We cannot remain the savage barbarians of the galaxy forever. We must temper our instincts if more civilized peoples are ever to respect us."

$envoy_events.210.desc.end$

entries.zh: 我方大使团因我们派驻[event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]的使者，[event_envoy.GetName]的工作情况而忧心已经有段日子了。而今曝光的证据表明[event_envoy.GetSheHe]似乎已沦为瘾君子，那是一种源自[provider_country.GetName]的外星药品，已经证明它就[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]而言极具成瘾性。\n\n尽管交易这种药品在[provider_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]严重违法，但冷酷无情的毒枭们掌管的黑市日进斗金，生意兴隆。这些毒枭们貌似是把这种药品作为强效春药介绍给了[event_envoy.GetHerHim]，[event_envoy.GetName]因而被毒枭玩弄于股掌之间，被迫俯首听命来换取用以满足[event_envoy.GetHerHis]瘾癖的药品。
entries.en: Our ambassador corps has for some time been concerned at the performance of [event_envoy.GetName], one of our officials to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]. Now, evidence has come to light that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] appear[event_envoy.GetSXX] to have fallen prey to an alien substance from the [provider_country.GetName] that has proven extremely addictive to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\nAlthough the trade in this substance is highly illegal among the [provider_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], a lucrative black market run by cutthroat drug lords has sprung up. These drug lords, who apparently managed to introduce it to [event_envoy.GetHerHim] as a potent aphrodisiac, now exert a considerable degree of influence over [event_envoy.GetName], who is forced to do their bidding in return for satisfying [event_envoy.GetHerHis] cravings.

entries.zh: §Y[event_envoy.GetName]§!将被紧急替换。然而，事实会证明我们不可能掩盖外交使团的污点。
entries.en: §Y[event_envoy.GetName]§! is replaced with immediate effect. However, it will prove impossible to cover up this stain on our diplomatic corps.

entries.zh: 我们一位特使的私人对话录音的外泄使[offended_party.GetName]怒不可遏。录音中有一段令人遗憾，[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNotCap][event_envoy.GetName]似乎将[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的东道主称为“恶心的[offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]”
entries.en: Leaked recordings of one of our envoys' private conversations have the [offended_party.GetName] up in arms. In a regrettable moment, [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNotCap] [event_envoy.GetName] seems to have called [event_envoy.GetHerHis] hosts "disgusting [offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]"

entries.zh: [offended_party.GetAdj][offended_party.GetRulerTitle]表示沮丧，并提议称将这么一位不适任者放在这样的岗位上“令人担忧”。
entries.en: The [offended_party.GetAdj] [offended_party.GetRulerTitle] expressed dismay, and suggested that keeping someone so demonstrably unfit for the role in place would be "concerning".
